Meet Dan Saltman, CEO of Redact.dev - who has recently taken on a personal crusade to stop Twitch in its tracks and change the website. He has galvanized a community around him and also taken it upon himself to speak with advertisers about the declining quality of content at Twitch. This is an extremely interesting conversation that goes in depth about the Twitch platform and discusses Twitch's advertising issues.
